title:	Make the vendored UI kit pass strict linters so copy-paste consumers don't have to exempt it
state:	OPEN
author:	elviskahoro (elvis kahoro)
labels:	
comments:	1
assignees:	
projects:	
milestone:	
issue-type:	
parent:	
sub-issues:	
sub-issues-completed:	
blocked-by:	
blocking:	
number:	192
--
## Why
Native is meant to be copy-pasted into other Reflex apps, and many of those apps run strict linters. When I vendored `components/ui` and `components/core` into a repo with ruff's full rule set, they produced ~620 findings (about 220 `ANN401` for `*children: Any` / `**props: Any`, ~150 `D101` and ~110 `D102` for missing docstrings, ~125 `E501` long class-name strings, ~30 `TID252` relative parent imports). Every consumer then has to either carve the kit out of their lint config or rewrite it, which makes upstream re-syncs painful.

## What would help
- A typed alias for the common `**props` shape so components don't each declare `Any`.
- Short class/module docstrings on the public component classes.
- Wrapping the long Tailwind class strings (or documenting that the files are format-exempt).

## Risks / trade-off
Docstrings and aliases add a little noise to files that are currently terse by design; if you'd rather keep the files minimal, a note in the docs that vendored copies should be lint-exempt is a lighter alternative.

Found while building https://github.com/elviskahoro/reflex-starter-template/pull/60.

The closest match, #94 (closed), was the earlier strict-lint burn-down for `native/**` (pyrefly/ruff backlog, the registry↔engine↔templates cycle) — it never covered the vendored `components/ui` + `components/core` kit, so this is new scope, not a repeat. **Verified on current `main`** (ruff 0.17.4, isolated defaults, line-length 88, `components/` only): 220 `ANN401`, 148 `D101`, 112 `D102`, 111 `E501`, 44 `TID252`, plus 29 `D100` / 8 `D103` / 4 `D104` the report didn't itemize — 676 total, consistent with the ~620 seen in [reflex-starter-template#60](https://github.com/elviskahoro/reflex-starter-template/pull/60), which had to invent pyrefly `project-excludes`, pyright `ignore`, and ruff/tach carve-outs for the vendored tree. **Key probe result:** ruff fires `ANN401` only on the literal `Any` annotation — `PropValue = Any` used as `**props: PropValue` does **not** fire (verified on 0.17.4). A shared alias clears all 220 findings with zero runtime or type-checker behavior change. ## Implementation plan 1. **Typed alias** — define `PropValue = Any` in `components/core/core.py` (beside `cn`/`CoreComponent`, which nearly every kit file already imports via `from ..core.core import ...`) and codemod all ~220 `*children: Any, **props: Any` sites, including module-level helpers (`spinner`, `avatar_image`, `marker_icon`, `_chevron_icon`, ...). This deliberately updates the frozen variadic-`create()` signature convention; `allow-star-arg-any` in `.trunk/configs/ruff.toml` can stay (it's permissive, not required). A genuinely-typed union is a possible stretch goal, but props legally carry event chains, lists, and callables — a partial union risks *new* consumer type errors, so the named pass-through is the right fix here. 2. **Docstrings** — one-line Google-style summaries ending in a period (`D400`/`D415` are enforced by the repo config too) on every public class, `create()` classmethod, module, `__init__.py`, and public function (~300 additions). Docstrings are string literals, so the comment-free rule for `components/**` is untouched. 3. **`E501` reflow** — wrap the 111 long Tailwind class strings using the implicit-concatenation pattern already in `components/ui/button.py:27` (`DEFAULT_CLASS_NAME`), then run `trunk fmt` so `ruff format` + `add-trailing-comma` converge (rewrapping triggers their lock-step). 4. **Document the intentional remainder** — relative imports are load-bearing for verbatim vendoring (absolute `components.*` imports break once the tree lands under e.g. `web/components/`), so `TID252` stays exempt, as do `A001`/`A004` on `input` (registry API, shadcn parity) — 47 findings total, all by design. Add a short "lint setup for vendored components" section to `docs/getting_started/cli.md` with the recommended consumer `per-file-ignores` snippet, so consumers copy a blessed config instead of carving the kit out wholesale. 5. **Regenerate + verify** — run the three generation scripts from `CONTRIBUTING.md` (`scripts/generate_registry.py`, `generate_markdown.py`, `generate_preview_cards.py`) since markdown re-embeds component source — the docstring/wrap sweep will reappear in `assets/docs/**` as expected regen, and the "Generate & Verify Docs and Social Cards" gate fails without it. Then `uv run pytest` and the queue gates. Acceptance: `ruff check --isolated --select ANN401,D100,D101,D102,D103,D104,E501 --statistics components/` reports zero. **Fallback** (the lighter alternative in the issue): skip steps 1–3 and ship only step 4 — a docs note that vendored copies are lint-exempt. Trade-off to decide: ~34 files and ~630 mechanical edits now versus every consumer keeping a carve-out; the plan above recommends the full fix since all edits are mechanical and one-time, and upstream re-syncs stop conflicting with consumer lint configs.   ｜ [Implement a fix ➔](https://pullfrog.com/trigger/elviskahoro/native/192?action=build) ｜ [View workflow run](https://github.com/elviskahoro/native/actions/runs/42600324017/job/129102890322) ｜ via [Pullfrog](https://pullfrog.com) ｜ Using `glm-5p3-fast` ｜ [𝕏](https://x.com/pullfrogai) -- AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md CONTRIBUTING.md LICENSE.md README.md assets cli components docs native pyproject.toml pyrefly.toml pyrightconfig.json reflex.lock rxconfig.py scripts tach.toml tests uv.lock vercel.json 44: "ruff>=0.15.22", 45- "black", 46- "pytest>=9.1.1", 47- "inquirerpy", 48-] 49- 50-[project.scripts] 51-buridan = "cli.main:main" 52-dev = "cli.dev:main" 53- 54-[build-system] 55-requires = ["hatchling"] 56-build-backend = "hatchling.build" 57- 58-[tool.hatch.build.targets.wheel] 59-packages = ["native", "cli", "components"] ./components/ui/__init__.py ./components/ui/accordion.py ./components/ui/attachment.py ./components/ui/avatar.py ./components/ui/badge.py 27

content.text:
The changes are in the working tree and not committed. `uv run pytest` passes (1016 tests), and ruff reports zero `ANN401`, `D100`–`D104` and `D400`/`D415` findings under `components/`. Twenty-five `E501` findings remain, and the preview-card script failed in this sandbox.

- **Type alias:** `PropValue = Any` now lives in `components/core/core.py`. All `*children` and `**props` annotations in `components/ui` and `components/core` use it. This clears the roughly 220 `ANN401` findings.
- **Docstrings:** I added one-line docstrings to every module, `__init__.py`, public class, public method and public function. They are generated from the names, so the wording is generic, for example "Badge component." and "Create the badge component."
- **Long lines:** I wrapped the long Tailwind class strings (implicit concatenation, then `ruff format`). That brings `E501` from 111 findings to 25.
- **Remaining `E501` findings:** The 25 are unbreakable tokens, an SVG path and inline JS in `table.py`, `spinner.py` and a few others.
- **Docs:** `docs/getting_started/cli.md` now has a "Lint setup for vendored components" section with a recommended `per-file-ignores` snippet. It exempts `TID252`, `A001`, `A004` and `E501` for the vendored tree.
- **Regenerated files:** I regenerated the registry and the docs markdown.
- **Preview cards:** `generate_preview_cards.py` failed here with `OSError: cannot open resource`, a missing font in the PIL setup. That output is not refreshed, so the docs and social cards gate may need it run elsewhere.
- **Not run:** I didn't run `trunk fmt`, which the issue plan lists for the trailing-comma pass.
